doctors.name: Dr. Ashish B. Matne
doctors.title: Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon (Mumbai)
doctors.bio: Jalna's implantologist and maxillofacial surgeon. Dr. Ashish treats dental implants, wisdom teeth, jaw and facial fractures, oral cancer and restricted mouth opening from gutkha or tobacco use, bringing hospital-grade surgical training from Mumbai to every procedure.

doctors.name: Dr. Smita A. Matne (Borey)
doctors.title: Dental Surgeon (MUHS, Nashik)
doctors.bio: Known for her calm, reassuring chairside manner. Dr. Smita handles root canals, cosmetic fillings, smile designing, whitening, gum care and children's dentistry for the whole family.

services.title: Dental Implants
services.desc: Permanent, natural-looking replacements for missing teeth, planned by a fellowship-trained implantologist.

services.title: Root Canal Treatment
services.desc: Save your natural tooth with modern rotary endodontics and effective anaesthesia, often in a single sitting.

services.title: Oral Cancer & Jaw Fracture Care
services.desc: Specialist diagnosis and treatment of oral cancer, jaw and tooth fractures, and restricted mouth opening from gutkha or tobacco use.

services.title: Wisdom Tooth & Extractions
services.desc: Gentle surgical removal of impacted wisdom teeth and painless extractions by a maxillofacial surgeon.

services.title: Braces & Teeth Straightening
services.desc: Correct crooked or gapped teeth with braces and clear aligners for children and adults.

services.title: Artificial Teeth & Crowns
services.desc: Fixed and removable dentures, caps, crowns and bridges that look natural and feel comfortable.

services.title: Smile Designing & Bleaching
services.desc: Smile makeovers, teeth whitening and tooth-coloured cosmetic fillings for a brighter, confident smile.

services.title: Dental X-Ray Diagnosis
services.desc: Digital dental X-rays for accurate diagnosis and clear, transparent treatment planning.

services.title: Kids' Dentistry & Cleaning
services.desc: Gentle first visits for children, plus machine scaling and polishing for healthy gums at every age.
